title: Errors
lead: Failed requests answer with a 4xx or 5xx status and an error object that names what went wrong.
body: The error's type groups the cause, its message is written for people, and param names the field when one parameter is at fault.
authentication_error - no key or a wrong one. invalid_request_error - a parameter is missing or malformed. resource_missing - no object with that id. rate_limit_error - too many requests.
